Build the platform every engineering team depends on and shape how Performativ scales through reliability, resilience, and world-class developer experience.

As our Hands-On Lead Cloud Engineer, you will lead Mission Control, our Platform Engineering and Reliability team. Mission Control creates secure, self-service platform capabilities that enable product teams to build, deploy, and operate services independently. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you'll spend the majority of your time building production infrastructure and platform capabilities, leading through technical contribution rather than process.

What you’ll do 📈

• 
Lead Mission Control while remaining deeply hands-on across cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and reliability.

• 
Build and evolve the default, secure-by-default platform that enables product teams to build, deploy, and operate services independently.

• 
Create reusable AWS CDK constructs, infrastructure standards, and golden paths that reduce complexity and improve the developer experience across engineering.

• 
Set the technical direction for Mission Control, making pragmatic decisions about platform evolution, reliability, and developer experience while helping the team execute.

• 
Strengthen our reliability practices through SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident tooling, and post-incident improvements that drive meaningful change.

• 
Treat cloud cost as a first-class engineering concern by improving visibility, eliminating waste, and designing systems that scale efficiently.

• 
Partner closely with our security specialists to build secure-by-default platform capabilities and continuously strengthen our security posture.

• 
Own the evolution of the engineering platform that enables every product team to build, deploy, and operate services independently.

• 
Provide technical leadership, coaching, and feedback to a small team of experienced platform engineers while remaining deeply involved in delivery.

What we’re looking for 🎯

• 
7+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar production-focused environments.

• 
Experience leading or mentoring engineers while remaining hands-on and actively contributing to code and infrastructure.

• 
Strong experience designing and operating production workloads on AWS, including Infrastructure as Code. Experience with AWS CDK and TypeScript is strongly preferred.

• 
Strong understanding of the AWS Well-Architected Framework and practical application of its principles.

• 
A platform engineering mindset focused on building reusable capabilities, self-service, and engineering leverage.

• 
Strong operational judgment with experience in incident response, reliability engineering, SLOs, and continuous improvement.

• 
Comfort owning outcomes, making decisions in ambiguous environments, and improving engineering practices without adding unnecessary process.

• 
Actively leverages AI and agent-assisted engineering workflows to improve productivity while applying sound engineering judgment and maintaining high quality standards.

• 
Experience working within fintech or other regulated industries is a plus.

Technologies you'll work with 💻

You don't need experience with every technology listed below. We care far more about strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and your ability to learn, build, and improve systems.

• 
Infrastructure & Cloud: AWS CDK (TypeScript), Terraform (bonus), and modern AWS infrastructure, networking, security, governance, and observability services.

• 
Engineering Tooling: GitHub Actions, Docker, container pipelines, cloud cost optimization, and observability tooling.

• 
Wider Engineering Stack: You'll collaborate with teams building services primarily in Golang and TypeScript, alongside React, React Native, Python, and PHP.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Trust and responsibility to shape the future of Performativ’s success in the European market from day 1.

• 
Join a fast-growing fintech scaleup supported by top-tier VCs.

• 
Work with intelligent, passionate, and driven professionals with experience from leading institutions (such as Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon etc).

• 
Accelerate your career with opportunities for professional development and leadership.

Join a Team of Fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is making waves in the wealth management ecosystem and is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions do business around the world. Working at Performativ means working at a fast-paced tech scaleup with intelligent people who are passionate about their work. We are on a scaling journey beyond all metrics and expectations and can't wait to have you join us in making a real impact.

We are funded by some of the leading VC funds in the world and expectations are set to be established as a European market leader in a record amount of time.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com

We value passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We are passionate with ambitious goals and value the time and effort people put into their work. You will be part of the family from day one, and responsible for making your mark and driving forward your vision. Autonomous work is embedded in our culture, and we are committed to ensure you have all the tools and support you need while acknowledging the importance of flexibility.

As a Senior Front-End Engineer, you will co-own the front-end experience for Performativ's trading and analytics platform, building high-performance interfaces used by wealth managers and financial institutions. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct ownership of architecture, implementation, and production outcomes.

About the team 👥

The engineering team owns the platform that powers portfolio management, trading, analytics, reporting, compliance, and client engagement at Performativ. Front-end engineers work closely with backend engineers, product, and design to turn complex financial workflows into software that advisors can use every day.

The team ships continuously and gives engineers ownership over implementation decisions. On the front end, the current focus is scaling a Next.js and React architecture across increasingly sophisticated workflows while keeping performance, server and client boundaries, theming, and shared components under control.

About the role 🎯

We are looking for a Senior Front-End Engineer to co-own the quality, performance, and architecture of our trading and analytics interfaces. This role is responsible for building production UIs, shaping front-end architecture, and raising the standard of our shared component infrastructure.

You will work closely with backend engineering, product, and design to ship financial workflows from requirements through production. You will co-own the end-to-end front-end scope, including server and client boundaries, hydration strategy, state management, performance, multi-tenant theming, testing, and the component library used across the platform.

This role requires deep React and TypeScript expertise, strong architectural judgment, and the ability to turn complex financial workflows into fast, usable interfaces. You need to be comfortable making implementation decisions independently and shipping production software without management overhead.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together from our city-center office, with working from home possible when there is a good reason. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What you'll do 📈

• 
Build high-performance trading, analytics, and portfolio management interfaces used by wealth management professionals.

• 
Co-own front-end architecture across Next.js 15, React Server Components, TypeScript, and our shared application infrastructure.

• 
Define server and client boundaries, hydration strategies, and state patterns that keep the platform responsive as complexity grows.

• 
Scale our shared component library and multi-tenant theming across the platform.

• 
Improve runtime performance, bundle size, rendering behavior, and application responsiveness.

• 
Ship production features quickly while making architectural decisions that hold up as the product scales.

• 
Use AI coding agents where they improve engineering throughput while maintaining control over code quality and implementation decisions.

• 
Strengthen front-end testing and delivery across Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and CI/CD workflows.

• 
Co-own implementation decisions from product outcome through production deployment.

What we're looking for 🔍

• 
Have built sophisticated production web applications with React and TypeScript and can structure front-end codebases that continue to work as product complexity grows.

• 
Understand modern React architecture, including React Server Components and the Next.js App Router, or can demonstrate the technical depth to become productive with them quickly.

• 
Have shipped production work using AI coding agents and understand where they improve engineering output and where direct engineering judgment is required.

• 
Have improved front-end performance through decisions around bundle size, hydration, rendering, data fetching, and runtime behavior.

• 
Are comfortable managing server state with TanStack Query and can make deliberate decisions about colocated state and client state libraries.

• 
Have built or extended component systems using tools such as Radix, shadcn/ui, or custom design systems.

• 
Understand usability, accessibility, and interaction design well enough to make sound UX decisions without treating design as somebody else's problem.

• 
Have shipped tested production software using tools such as Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

Preferred experience ➕

• 
Have worked on trading, investment management, portfolio analytics, or other data-intensive financial applications.

• 
Have worked with AG Grid or comparable data-grid infrastructure for complex datasets and interactions.

• 
Have worked in a pnpm and Turborepo monorepo with generated API types from OpenAPI specifications.

• 
Have designed front-end systems supporting multiple tenants, brands, or configurable themes.

• 
Have mentored engineers or raised engineering standards without moving away from hands-on development.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Work that reaches production fast. We ship weekly. Your work will be used by advisors and financial institutions within days, not quarters.

• 
Colleagues who set a high bar. Our team comes from Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, and Amazon. Standards are high. Politics are absent.

• 
Career compression. People here take on scope in twelve months that takes five years elsewhere. If you can carry it, we will give it to you.

• 
Direct access to founders, customers, and the market. You will sit in the rooms where decisions get made.

• 
Backing from leading venture funds, and a mandate to become the European standard rather than a regional alternative.

About Performativ 🚀

Wealth management runs on software built for a different era. Batch files. Overnight reconciliation. Client reports assembled by hand. Advisors spend more time fighting their systems than advising clients. The industry has accepted this for thirty years.

We are replacing that layer. Performativ is one platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, and client engagement, built from the ground up for how wealth is actually managed today. Banks, family offices, and independent advisors across Europe run on it.

We are a scaleup, not a startup. The product is live, the customers are real, and the growth is ahead of plan. We intend to be the system European wealth management runs on. That is not positioning. It is the plan we are executing against.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com

The bar 🔥

We are builders. We move fast, we say what we think, and we do not manage each other. Autonomy is the default, which only works if you are the kind of person who does not need to be told twice.

This is not a role for someone looking to coast inside a growing company. It is a role for someone who wants scope, wants pressure, and wants to point at something in two years and say they built it. If that is you, apply. If it is not, this will be uncomfortable, and we would rather say so now.

About BLAST

BLAST is a global competitive entertainment company working with some of the world's biggest game publishers, brands and entertainment properties to create world-class esports and live entertainment experiences.

We operate globally across multiple ecosystems, delivering everything from large-scale arena events and broadcasts to digital products and content.

Our values — Make it Bold, Make it Together and Make it Happen — shape how we work, collaborate and deliver.

Welcome to the Global Mobility Team at BLAST!

At BLAST, we bring people together – across borders, stages, and time zones. Now we’re  looking for a Global Mobility Consultant to join our team and help us ensure  that our people can thrive wherever in the world our events take them.

You’ll be part of a small but passionate team of colleagues, working closely with People and Culture, Travel,  Finance, Legal, and Live Events to build and run a world-class mobility framework that supports BLAST’s global growth.

What You’ll Be Doing – Your Impact

As our new Global Mobility Consultant, you’ll make it easier for people to move across  borders with confidence – whether they’re employees, freelancers, or part of our extended  network.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Acting as an advisor on international hires and postings

• Coordinating with P&O, Payroll, and external vendors (legal, tax, relocation)

• Managing work permit and visa applications, incl. compliance and documentation

• Providing guidance to cross-border employees and freelancers

• Drafting invitation and support letters

• Supporting the expansion of our Global Mobility hub and processes

• Liaising with specialised legal counsels as needed

• Handling admin tasks like budget tracking, PO creation, and updating WIPS

• Taking on other ad hoc tasks as the need arises – flexibility is key!

• Managing portfolio-wide shared services scope across key global operational regions

• Ensuring close cross-departmental collaboration with Travel, People Operations, and Legal

• Serving as the primary coordination point for all international mobility queries and escalation

• Providing dedicated talent and event-specific support for global tournament operations

• Driving process scalability and documentation across global mobility workflows

• High-Volume Event Scaling, managing visa and immigration logistics for large-scale international tournaments involving up to 400 personnel per event (including Third-Country Nationals, employees, and freelancers)

• Reviewing agreements with local partners and drafting special clauses regarding visa support, including negotiating terms, intervention costs, sourcing local vendors/counsel, and handling contract negotiations, term reviews, and cost analysis

• Direct interaction and coordination with immigration authorities, government departments, and local regulatory bodies, rather than solely liaising with external legal counsel.

• Local Entity Compliance & Corporate Service Provider Coordination, overseeing local corporate compliance requirements such as employer registrations, and local tax/social security considerations.

Who You Are – To Succeed in This Role

You're an excellent communicator, a proactive problem-solver, and a trusted partner to  your colleagues. You thrive in a dynamic environment, love the details, and care about  creating smooth experiences for people on the move.

Requirements

Experience:

• A degree in HR, Business Administration, Legal – or equivalent experience

• 3+ years of experience with international assignments and cross-border employment particularly in relation to North America and Asia

• Strong understanding of mobility processes and compliance

• Solid experience working with Excel (e.g. data management, formulas, reporting) Proficiency in tools like Smartsheet, Google Sheets, and AI and automation tools and platforms

• Experience providing team leadership, guidance, and mentorship within a small team environment

• Previous background in the sports, entertainment, or fast-paced live events industry, given the scale of international tournaments.

• Demonstrated flexibility, interpretation, and creativity in navigating complex or ambiguous visa regulations across global destinations lacking standardized visa categories.

• Experience with budget tracking, cost control, PO creation, and managing financial considerations related to global mobility and travel.

• Proven ability to manage high-pressure situations, tight event deadlines, and complex logistical escalations independently.

• Strong cross functional  stakeholder engagement skills to coordinate seamlessly across all the internal Blast teams as well as external vendors.

• Willingness to work flexible hours during major events or travel occasionally between the London and Copenhagen offices.

Benefits

What We Offer – Life at BLAST

• At BLAST, you’ll join a creative, collaborative, and international environment where no two  days are the same. We’re proud of our culture – one where people are seen, heard, and  encouraged to bring ideas forward.

Here’s a glimpse of what you’ll get:

• A fast-paced and supportive workplace

• Great colleagues

• Flexible working conditions

• Centrally located office in Copenhagen

Ready to join us?

We’re excited to meet you. Apply now and help us shape the future of Global Mobility at  BLAST

About ChemoMetec

ChemoMetec is a worldwide leading manufacturer of cell counting and analysis equipment. We specialize in developing and producing high-precision instrumentation, delivering consistent data for thousands of customers across biotech, pharma, and academic segments.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and scientifically skilled Product Specialist - Technical Support & Documentation to lead technical support for ChemoMetec’s portfolio of analytical cell-counting instruments. In this support-centered role, you will handle technical inquiries from both customers and colleagues and act as the go-to reference for technically accurate and compliant solutions. The role combines life science, technical documentation, and QA collaboration, making it ideal for someone with a strong scientific background and a passion for structured problem-solving.

We are hiring two Product Specialists for our technical support team: one focused on documentation and one on data analysis. You will be part of the Product Management Department and work closely with QA, Field Application Scientists, and product teams to resolve customer complaints, complete technical documentation, and maintain our support infrastructure. A solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, along with a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements, is essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical support across all instrument platforms, with a focus on structured problem-solving and documentation.

• Collaborate with QA to complete technical questionnaires and support the resolution of customer complaints.

• Maintain and organize our support database platform, ensuring technical records are accurate and accessible.

• Proofread and write technical notes, user guides, and comparison studies.

• Develop and implement procedures to support both existing and new products.

• Ensure all support activities comply with GMP and relevant quality standards.

• Act as a subject matter expert on instrumentation and scientific applications, providing technical insight to internal teams.

Your Profile

• PhD in Biology, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

• Solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, and a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements.

• Strong understanding of microscopy, analytical instrumentation, and pharmaceutical workflows.

• Highly organized, structured, and detail-oriented.

• Excellent written communication skills, with experience producing technical documentation.

• Familiarity with support platforms or ticketing systems is a plus.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, technical environment.

Why join ChemoMetec?

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

Practical information

Both positions are on-site at our HQ in Allerød, Denmark. You will refer to Director, Ph.D. Product Management Bassam Tawfik.

Starting date is as soon as possible, and we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Deadline for applying is 20 November 2026.

If you have any further questions about this job opportunity, feel free to contact Frederikke Hvidberg, fhv@chemometec.com

Join Pharmacosmos in a newly established function, in a role combining people leadership with direct involvement in clinical processes, compliance and continuous improvement.

Build and lead a new Clinical Administration & Compliance function

As Director, Clinical Administration & Compliance, you will report directly to the Senior Director, Head of Clinical Operations, Trine Kolding, and take on a key role combining leadership with hands-on responsibility for clinical trial administration, processes and operational GCP compliance.

You will lead and develop the Clinical Administration and Process Management functions, setting clear priorities and direction while fostering collaboration, accountability and high-quality delivery. At the same time, you will remain actively involved in developing, implementing and continuously improving processes that support effective and compliant clinical trial execution across R&D.

A key responsibility will be to translate ICH-GCP, regulatory expectations and internal requirements into practical, risk-based ways of working. You will contribute directly to operational compliance, documentation practices, TMF quality, sponsor oversight and inspection readiness, ensuring that processes are robust, pragmatic and consistently applied. Working closely with trial teams and stakeholders across R&D, you will identify opportunities to simplify and strengthen processes and drive improvements through implementation.

A hands-on leader who enjoys making compliance work in practice

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience from clinical research or clinical development within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or CRO environment, combined with strong practical knowledge of ICH-GCP and the processes and documentation required to execute and oversee clinical trials. You have hands-on experience with clinical trial processes, SOP implementation, TMF and essential documentation, as well as inspection readiness.

You have gained leadership experience, ideally within Clinical Operations, Clinical Process Management or a related area, while remaining motivated by direct involvement in the work. Experience working across functions and navigating multiple stakeholders within an R&D and trial-execution environment is essential.

You genuinely enjoy working with clinical processes, compliance and continuous improvement and are motivated by a role that combines leadership with hands-on responsibility. You bring a pragmatic and risk-based mindset, enabling you to translate regulatory requirements into practical ways of working while balancing compliance, simplicity and effective trial delivery.

As a person, you are structured, collaborative and confident in engaging stakeholders across Clinical Operations and the wider R&D organization. You are comfortable setting direction and priorities while staying close to the details, and you have the judgement and drive to identify areas for improvement and turn them into sustainable ways of working. You communicate clearly at all levels and have the natural authority to engage and motivate people. You are fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

Join a highly collaborative Clinical Operations team

You will join a highly collaborative Clinical Operations environment built on trust, ownership and strong collegial relationships. We learn from each other, share responsibility and solve new challenges together rather than working in silos.

As Pharmacosmos continues to grow, you will have a genuine opportunity to shape how we work as the organization develops and make a visible contribution to both Clinical Operations and the wider R&D organization.

Play a crucial role in an exciting international growth journey

This is your chance to embark upon a personal and organizational journey in a dynamic company where your know-how is greatly needed for the future development of Pharmacosmos. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search. For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Sr. Executive Search Consultant, Lars Nordlund, on +45 3123 3018. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV - it is not necessary to include a cover letter.

Pharmacosmos

Pharmacosmos A/S is a global leader in carbohydrate chemistry and innovative treatments for iron deficiency and iron deficiency anaemia. Building on our foundational expertise in carbohydrate chemistry and cell cycle biology, we develop innovative treatments for unmet patient needs, with a focus on iron metabolism and blood-related disorders. Founded in 1965 and headquartered in Denmark, our team is made up of more than 650 specialists across the UK, Ireland, the Nordics, Germany, Canada, and the USA. Learn more about Pharmacosmos at www.pharmacosmos.com.

**

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Job Description:

In order to properly promote our after-sale products and services on the world stage, we are looking for a Product Marketing Manager (f/m) within Satair (a 100% subsidiary of Airbus) in Copenhagen to join the Marketing team at the earliest possible start date. You will coordinate effectively with members of different departments within Satair and Airbus, as well as external partners, in order to ensure the smooth running of your marketing projects through to completion.

Reporting to our Head of Marketing and Communication Satair and working out of our Headquarters in Copenhagen, with half of the Marketing & Communication team in Hamburg and with commercial teams spread around the world, you will have a global responsibility to drive, prioritize, structure and focus Satair products and services marketing initiatives effectively, in support of our commercial strategy. You will have a unique opportunity to make a difference in this new role which will also require leadership skills as you will indirectly manage a team of specialists to achieve the objectives that you will be setting.

Tasks & accountabilities

• Craft compelling value propositions, messaging frameworks, and multi-channel marketing campaigns that resonate with aviation industry stakeholders.

• Oversee marketing project lifecycles from concept to completion. You will manage resources, timelines, external agencies, and budget allocation to ensure maximum impact and brand reach.

The team mission we are on: Engineering Services is a small team of experts finding solutions to a wide variety of challenges. In pre-sales we are supporting our AE's and Solution Consultants with feasibility testing the most complex customer setups or requirements. Often directly with the customers and their technical teams. In post-sales we collaborate with Cloud, FW and HW teams, and build and support a range of custom solutions. Our core mission is to increase documentation, standardization and empowering our colleagues in both pre- and post-sales roles to server the customers in the most technical cases.

**What You'll Do

**

• Answer feasibility questions from Sales: can we connect this machine, PLC, or sensor, and how

• Design and build custom solutions: logic boxes, signal converters, IO-Link modules, EDGE flows, and Factbird® powered by OMRON NX1 programs that fill gaps the cloud platform can’t handle yet.

• Design the integration: map the customer’s OT/IT environment and plan the data sources, tag structures, transformations, and security.

• Root cause troubleshooting in live production. Smaller share of time, highest stakes

• Document everything you build and fix: Solution Records, runbooks, and wiring guides for customers and internal teams, clear enough that someone else can pick it up. Version and back up every configuration.

• Bench-test hardware before it ships, test the full data flow end to end (including failure recovery and restarts), and hand hardware to Logistics with a clear packing list.

• Integrate customer systems through Kepware, Ignition, OPC UA, MQTT, EtherNet/IP, Modbus, and Node-RED.

• Share what you know: help Support, Solution Consultants, and Hardware handle more on their own.

• Streamline as you go: spot repeat work and clunky processes, and fix them or flag them. Build templates and scripts that make the next delivery faster.

• Turn repeat workarounds into product input with a business case, so the workaround can disappear.

• Join customer and prospect calls as the technical voice alongside Solution Consultants and Account Managers.

**About you

**You’re an experienced industrial automation engineer, as happy with a screwdriver as with a terminal. You know how factories work, and you’re comfortable saying “not directly, but here’s the route.”

You document like the next person depends on it, because they do. You can’t leave a clunky process alone: you always have an eye on how to make things simpler and more repeatable.

You’re flexible and self-directed: you take a high level of accountability and ownership. You can prioritize and deliver without daily supervision, and you troubleshoot systematically when things get ambiguous. The work changes week to week, and the team’s shape will keep evolving as Factbird grows. You’re happy to do what’s needed today while helping move things in a more scalable direction.

You love being the expert, but you equally love teaching others and making the teams around you smarter. And most of all, you care about making the answer simple for whoever asked.

Requirements:

• A bachelor's degree in automation, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or similar, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• At least 5 years in industrial automation or controls engineering, including hands-on work on the shop floor (7+ years preferred).

• Hands-on PLC experience with at least one major vendor, e.g. Siemens, Omron, or Rockwell/Allen-Bradley.

• Solid understanding of industrial protocols, e.g. OPC UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, MQTT.

• Working knowledge of sensors and signals, like digital, analog (4–20 mA, 0–10 V), IO-Link, PNP/NPN, and energy metering.

• Root cause analysis across hardware, networks, and software in live production environments.

• Field experience commissioning or troubleshooting equipment in live plants.

• Comfortable troubleshooting site networks, e.g. IP setup, routers, SIMs, and firewalls.

• A clear communicator in English who can explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.

• A strong documentation habit: when you build it, you write it down.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Khristel, our Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Lead at **khma@factbird.com

**_At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

__All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws.

_We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

**Job Title: Global Service Specialist – DO/EIMCO, Flotation, PCV, DSG

****Position Summary

**FLS is seeking a highly skilled and professional Global Service Specialist to support the erection, installation, pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and operational startup of commercial and industrial separation equipment. This role focuses primarily on mechanical work and Installation & Commissioning (I&C) activities for thickeners and flotation cells, with additional responsibility for equipment such as clarifiers, cyclones, pumps, reactors, and agitated tanks.

The Global Service Specialist serves as FLS’s primary onsite representative and is responsible for delivering high‑quality technical service, maintaining strong customer relationships, and ensuring safe and efficient project execution. This position requires extensive international travel and the ability to work independently under demanding conditions.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Execute onsite erection, installation, alignment, and commissioning of mechanical systems and I&C activities for thickeners, flotation cells, and related separation equipment.

• Lead pre‑commissioning and commissioning processes to ensure equipment meets design, safety, and performance requirements.

• Support operational startup, troubleshooting, and optimization of equipment performance.

• Conduct inspections, testing, calibration, and verification of mechanical and control‑related systems.

• Coordinate onsite project activities, schedules, and resources to ensure timely completion.

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and project management teams to resolve technical issues.

• Prepare accurate and professional documentation, including installation records, commissioning reports, and service summaries.

• Maintain compliance with all safety, quality, and regulatory standards.

• Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for customers, providing training, guidance, and technical support.

• Represent FLS with professionalism and integrity in all customer interactions.

**Qualifications

****Required

**

• Strong mechanical background with hands‑on experience in Installation & Commissioning (I&C) of industrial process equipment.

• Experience with thickeners, flotation cells, clarifiers, cyclones, pumps, reactors, or similar industrial equipment.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently and make informed decisions under pressure.

• Strong project management skills, including planning, coordination, and documentation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce high‑quality technical reports.

• Ability and willingness to travel internationally up to 70% of the time.

• Professional demeanor with the ability to represent the company effectively onsite.

**Preferred

**

• Experience in commissioning or startup of industrial process systems.

• Background in mining, minerals processing, water treatment, or heavy industrial environments.

• Multilingual capabilities or experience working in multicultural settings.

• Ability to meet all medical and physical fitness requirements necessary to obtain work authorization for high‑altitude job sites.

**Competencies

**

• Technical proficiency in mechanical systems and industrial equipment

• Strong problem‑solving and decision‑making abilities

• Customer service orientation

• Professional communication and reporting skills

• Ability to perform effectively in high‑pressure environments

• Self‑motivation and independence in field operations

We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

**Your impact begins here

**As Safety Surveillance Principal Process Specialist, you will keep Safety Surveillance ready for every audit and inspection, and make sure the way we monitor safety information keeps pace with legislation. You will be a highly visible process expert: leading our contribution to inspections, co-driving regulatory surveillance and shaping how we integrate processes after acquisitions. Your work keeps surveillance of Novo’s marketed and developmental products compliant, simpler and focused on the work that adds most value.

**What You’ll Bring

**You know drug safety from the inside, and you know what it takes to get an organisation ready for an inspection. You will also bring:

• A Master’s degree in Life Sciences, such as Pharmacy, Medicine, Veterinary Science or Biology, or a related field.

• At least 5–7 years of experience in pharmacovigilance, including supporting safety activities in clinical trials.

• Hands-on experience facilitating inspection set-ups, training colleagues and preparing an organisation for audits and inspections.

• Expertise in Safety Surveillance processes and an enterprise mindset: you understand the end-to-end process and can turn complex internal and external requirements into practical ways of working.

• A solid background in handling deviations and implementing process changes.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior internal stakeholders and external parties, and a collaborative mindset across functions and geographies.

• Resilience and a calm demeanour in a very busy environment, with the ability to multitask and prioritise your workload through complexity and challenge.

**Desirable, But Not Essential

**Experience in process management and project management.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be a recognised expert in key Safety Surveillance processes, helping the team work with greater simplicity and focus. The role covers a diverse range of tasks, and you could be part of an inspection from day one.

• Lead audits and inspections: coordinate Safety Surveillance contributions, prepare colleagues for interviews, ensure high-quality responses and keep oversight of findings and the associated corrective and preventive actions.

• Act as Process Expert for the signal management process and co-drive the Regulatory Surveillance process, ensuring full compliance with applicable legislation.

• Handle deviations and change requests in close collaboration with colleagues in Safety Surveillance and other relevant functions.

• Support integration and acquisition activities by helping integrate pharmacovigilance processes and systems following company or product acquisitions and mergers.

• Contribute to process improvement projects aligned with our strategic objectives, using your end-to-end view of Safety Surveillance.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Safety Surveillance Centre of Expertise, a team of five engaged and skilled colleagues within Safety Surveillance, and report to the Director of Safety Surveillance Centre of Expertise.

Safety Surveillance is a department within Global Patient Safety in Research & Development, with departments in Bangalore, India, and Boston, US. Together, we are globally accountable for surveillance of all safety information for Novo’s marketed products and products in development. We also handle safety label updates, Risk Management Plans and aggregate reports.

You will work closely with colleagues across Safety Surveillance and partner with Global Patient Safety, other headquarters functions and affiliates during audits and inspections. When processes need to change, you will bring the right people together, create clarity on what needs to happen and help the team move forward with pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have real visibility as a process expert, and the opportunity to influence how Safety Surveillance works and make a lasting impact. You will be trusted to take ownership, encouraged to make your voice heard, and supported by colleagues who give honest feedback and never compromise on patient safety or quality.

The pace is high and the work is varied. Through process improvement projects and a broad range of tasks, you will build new skills and deepen your understanding of safety surveillance end to end.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000 to

1,245,100 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

**Start now

**Your impact begins today, so apply by 17 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

Do you have a passion for helping clients navigate complex technology landscapes and turn architecture into a strategic advantage? Would you like to advise some of Denmark's leading brands on platform selection and future-proof architecture? If so, you may be the Senior Consultant we're looking for to join our Tech Enablement team in Copenhagen.

At Novicell, we help companies unlock their full digital potential. We combine creative thinking and technical expertise with strategic innovation to deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable business results. Our diverse team of specialists shares one ambition: to create outstanding customer experiences, drive growth, and challenge the boundaries of digital.

**Your Responsibilities

**

**Practical details

**

• We review applications continuously and will close the process once the right candidate is found

• If you have any questions, please contact Kasper Madsen at kas@novicell.dk

We look forward to receiving your application!

**Global Regulatory & R&D Quality

****Søborg, Denmark

****Your impact begins here

**As Experienced Medical Writer, you will turn complex clinical data into clear, accurate documents that move drug development forward. Covering maternity leave for one year in Regulatory Scientific Writing, you will lead the planning and preparation of the documents that support clinical trials and health authority submissions. Your work helps project teams communicate what trials show, on time and with confidence, so new treatments can reach people living with serious chronic diseases.

**What You’ll Bring

**To succeed in this role, you have:

• A Master’s degree within natural sciences (MSc, MSc Pharm or equivalent).

• A track record of driving complex tasks from start to end while navigating a multidisciplinary group of stakeholders.

• A high level of expertise in communicating scientific information, and the ability to tailor it to different objectives.

• A good understanding of clinical development, regulatory processes and requirements, and clinical documents.

• The ability to improve processes and promote the sharing of better practices.

• Full proficiency in spoken and written English.

• Strong planning and coordination skills, and the ability to adapt to a changing environment with tight deadlines.

• A collaborative, proactive approach: you manage stakeholders well, reach consensus and are not afraid to challenge the status quo.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**A PhD and/or relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

**What You’ll Do

**You will act as both writer and project manager, driving regulatory documents from first plan to final version.

• Lead the planning, development and oversight of regulatory documents, including study protocols, informed consent forms, investigator’s brochures, clinical summaries, paediatric plans, briefing packages and responses to health agency questions.

• Represent Regulatory Scientific Writing (RSW) on cross-functional project teams, advising on how to plan regulatory documents, what they require and how best to present the data.

• Work with colleagues across Research & Development to make sure source information and data are reported accurately and completely, and interpreted scientifically.

• Keep documents on track against project timelines and business needs.

• Share better practices and look for simpler ways of working.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join RSW, the medical writing function at Novo, with 200+ medical writers worldwide. RSW is part of Research & Development (R&D) and anchored together with Regulatory and Quality functional areas. R&D manages clinical drug development and submissions to health authorities worldwide, from early development to market authorisation. RSW covers all clinical drug development projects across therapy areas.

In project teams, your closest partners will be colleagues in Medical & Science, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics and Pharmacovigilance, among others. You will work with colleagues in Denmark and abroad, and your clarity around timelines and data presentation will help these teams make decisions and move forward together. The position is office-based in Søborg, Denmark.

**What You Can Expect Here

**This is a one-year temporary position. You will join a supportive culture that values continuous learning, being bold and striving for simplicity. You will be trusted to own your documents and make your voice heard in cross-functional teams, while growing your expertise alongside colleagues across R&D and the wider medical writing community.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.
